title: School Management System
overview: The School Management System is a web-based platform built for managing academic activities, administrative operations, and student records. It features dedicated interfaces for Admins, Teachers, and Students, enabling functionality such as attendance marking, grade publication, targeted announcements, user record management, and customizable reporting.

roles.name: Teacher
roles.description: Instructors who manage academic activities including attendance, grading, and class announcements.
permissions: create, edit, and delete class announcements
roles.evidence_quote: The teacher’s interface allows instructors to manage academic activities.

roles.name: Admin
roles.description: Administrators with full control over user records, system configurations, and reporting.
permissions: create, read, update, and delete teacher and student records
assign teachers to subjects and classes
view and export attendance summaries and grade reports
roles.evidence_quote: The admin interface provides full control over user and system management operations.

roles.name: Student
roles.description: Enrolled students who view academic results, attendance, announcements, and manage profile details.
permissions: view attendance records and summary percentages
view announcements relevant to enrolled classes
update profile photo, contact information, and password
roles.evidence_quote: The student interface is designed for easy access to academic updates.

requirements.title: Main Page Login Options
requirements.text: The system shall display the main navigation page containing three login options: Admin Login, Teacher Login, and Student Login.
requirements.evidence_quote: 1. The system shall display the main navigation page containing three login options: Option 1: Admin Login Option 2: Teacher Login Option 3: Student Login

requirements.title: Main Page Navigation Links
requirements.text: The main page shall include navigation buttons or links for About, Contact, and Help.
requirements.evidence_quote: 3. The main page shall also include the following buttons or links: About: Displays brief information about the system. Contact: Shows contact details for support or queries. Help: Provides FAQs or user guidance.

requirements.title: Teacher Dashboard Navigation
requirements.text: After successful login, the system shall open the Teacher Dashboard showing quick links to Attendance, Grading, and Announcements.
requirements.evidence_quote: 1. After successful login, the system shall open the Teacher Dashboard showing quick links to Attendance, Grading, and Announcements.

requirements.title: Attendance Student List
requirements.text: The system shall list enrolled students with mark options when a teacher selects Class, Subject, and Date.
requirements.evidence_quote: System lists enrolled students with mark options.

requirements.title: Save Attendance
requirements.text: The system shall record attendance and display a success message when the teacher saves the attendance form.
requirements.evidence_quote: ”Save” records attendance and shows a success message.

requirements.title: Edit Attendance
requirements.text: The system shall allow teachers to edit attendance records for the same date.
requirements.evidence_quote: Teacher may edit attendance for the same date.

requirements.title: Grading Student List
requirements.text: The system shall display enrolled students with input fields for marks when a teacher selects Class and Assessment.
requirements.evidence_quote: System displays students with input fields for marks.

requirements.title: Auto-compute Grades
requirements.text: The system shall automatically compute total score, percentage, and grade letter per the configured grading scheme.
requirements.evidence_quote: Total/percentage and grade letter are auto-computed per configured scheme.

requirements.title: Grade Draft and Publishing
requirements.text: The system shall allow teachers to save grades as draft or publish results, displaying only published grades to students.
requirements.evidence_quote: Teacher can save as draft or publish results; students see only published grades.

requirements.title: Bulk Grade Entry
requirements.text: The system shall provide CSV upload and download functionality for bulk grade entry.
requirements.evidence_quote: CSV upload/download is provided for bulk grade entry.

requirements.title: Teacher Announcement Management
requirements.text: The system shall allow teachers to create, edit, and delete announcements targeted to selected classes.
requirements.evidence_quote: Teacher can create, edit, and delete announcements targeted to selected classes.

requirements.title: Teacher Class Scope
requirements.text: The system shall allow teachers to select only classes that are assigned to them.
requirements.evidence_quote: Only classes assigned to the teacher are selectable.

requirements.title: Admin Student Management
requirements.text: The system shall allow administrators to create, read, update, and delete student records including name, ID, class, and contact information.
requirements.evidence_quote: Admin can create, read, update, and delete (CRUD) student records (name, ID, class, contact).

requirements.title: Student Promotion and Deactivation
requirements.text: The system shall allow administrators to promote students to the next class and deactivate student records.
requirements.evidence_quote: Admin can promote students to next class and deactivate records.

requirements.title: Admin Teacher Management
requirements.text: The system shall allow administrators to create, read, update, and delete teacher records.
requirements.evidence_quote: Admin can CRUD teacher records (name, ID, subjects, contact).

requirements.title: Teacher Account Status and Password Reset
requirements.text: The system shall allow administrators to activate or deactivate teacher accounts and reset passwords.
requirements.evidence_quote: Admin can activate/deactivate teacher accounts and reset passwords.

requirements.title: Teacher Assignment Validation
requirements.text: The system shall prevent scheduling conflicts such as same teacher or time clashes when assigning teachers to classes and subjects.
requirements.evidence_quote: System prevents conflicts (same teacher/time clash) and shows validation errors.

requirements.title: Admin Announcements
requirements.text: The system shall allow administrators to publish global or targeted announcements by class or role.
requirements.evidence_quote: Admin can publish global or targeted announcements (by class or role).

requirements.title: Reporting and Export
requirements.text: The system shall allow administrators to view and export Attendance Summaries and Grade Reports to PDF and CSV formats.
requirements.evidence_quote: Admin can view and export Attendance Summary (by class/date range) and Grade Reports (by class/subject/term) to PDF/CSV.

requirements.title: Student Attendance Filtering
requirements.text: The system shall allow students to filter attendance records by subject and download a PDF summary.
requirements.evidence_quote: Student can filter by subject and download a PDF summary.

requirements.title: Student Transcript Download
requirements.text: The system shall allow students to download a transcript or term report as a PDF.
requirements.evidence_quote: Student can download a transcript/term report as PDF.

requirements.title: Student Profile Customization
requirements.text: The system shall allow students to update their profile photo, contact information, and password with validation.
requirements.evidence_quote: Student may update profile photo, contact info, and password.

requirements.title: Student Data Access Control
requirements.text: The system shall allow students to access only their own records and deny attempts to access other students' data.
requirements.evidence_quote: Students can access only their own records; attempts to access others’ data are denied and redirected to dashboard.

requirements.title: Dashboard Load Time
requirements.text: The user dashboard shall load and display all key summary widgets within 8 seconds of successful login.
requirements.evidence_quote: The user dashboard (Admin, Teacher, or Student) shall load and display all key summary widgets (e.g., current announcements, grade summaries, quick links) within 8 seconds of successful login.

requirements.title: Attendance Save Speed
requirements.text: The total time required to process and save a full class attendance record shall not exceed 5 seconds.
requirements.evidence_quote: The total time required to process and save a full class attendance record (from clicking Save to receiving the success message) shall not exceed 5 seconds.

requirements.title: Search Responsiveness
requirements.text: All filtering operations on lists shall return results within 5 seconds.
requirements.evidence_quote: All filtering operations on lists (e.g., filtering student records by class, or filtering reports by terms) shall return results within 5 seconds.

requirements.title: Grade Publication Speed
requirements.text: The system shall publish grades for a class of up to 50 students within 8 seconds of clicking Publish.
requirements.evidence_quote: The system shall publish grades for a class of up to 50 students, making them visible to students, within 8 seconds of the teacher clicking the Publish button.

requirements.title: Report Generation Speed
requirements.text: The time taken to generate and present an exportable grade report or attendance summary for a single class over one term shall not exceed 10 seconds.
requirements.evidence_quote: The time taken for the system to generate and present an exportable grade report or attendance summary (PDF/CSV) for a single class over one term shall not exceed 10 seconds.

requirements.title: Automated Daily Backup
requirements.text: The system must implement an automated, daily backup mechanism for the SQLite database file stored in a secure separate location.
requirements.evidence_quote: The system must implement an automated, daily backup mechanism for the entire SQLite database file, stored in a secure, separate location to prevent data loss in the event of system failure.

requirements.title: Input Validation
requirements.text: All user input forms shall implement client-side and server-side validation to prevent injection attacks and ensure data integrity.
requirements.evidence_quote: All user input forms (especially grading, attendance marking, and profile updates) shall implement client-side and server-side validation to prevent injection attacks and ensure data integrity.

requirements.title: Destructive Action Confirmation
requirements.text: Any action resulting in permanent deletion or deactivation of data must require mandatory two-step confirmation.
requirements.evidence_quote: Any action that results in the permanent dele- tion or deactivation of data (e.g., deleting a user account or deleting an announcement) must require a mandatory two-step confirmation

requirements.title: Session-based Authentication
requirements.text: User authentication must use session-based authentication.
requirements.evidence_quote: User authentication must use session-based authentication.

requirements.title: Password Hashing
requirements.text: All passwords must be stored using a strong, one-way hashing algorithm.
requirements.evidence_quote: All passwords must be stored using a strong, one-way hashing algorithm.

requirements.title: Audit Logging
requirements.text: The system shall log all sensitive administrative actions and unauthorized access attempts for audit purposes.
requirements.evidence_quote: The system shall log all sensitive administrative actions (e.g., user creation, password resets, teacher assignment) and unauthorized access attempts for audit purposes.
